elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiration or termination of the Agreement for any reason.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”
Subsection d) requires MSL to provide the transition assistance described in Subsection 5.2(a)(ii), which covers transfer of MSL responsibilities and Products to IBM or its designee.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) guarantees assistance only for “at least ninety (90) Days”; it does not guarantee availability through six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at MSL's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Neither subsection d) nor the displayed incorporated language specifies then-current rates or any other pricing for transition assistance.

elements.element: MSL must return all Customer Data to IBM.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) requires MSL to “export and deliver to IBM all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for IBM” in MSL's possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) expressly requires export and delivery within thirty days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires export and delivery but specifies no format or machine-readability standard.

elements.element: MSL must delete remaining Customer Data after returning it.
MSL must certify deletion of the Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification obligation is included.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiration or termination of the Agreement for any reason.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) expressly covers expiration or termination “for any reason.”
Subsection d) requires MSL to provide the transition assistance described in Subsection 5.2(a)(ii).

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided for 90 days following expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) requires transition assistance “for a period of at least ninety (90) Days” following expiration or termination.

elements.element: MSL must export and deliver IBM's data to IBM.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) requires export and delivery to IBM of all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for IBM that is in MSL's possession or control.

elements.element: The data export must occur within 30 days after expiration or termination.
elements.evidence: Subsection d) expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline.

result.reason: The redline fully implements the fallback by extending transition assistance to every expiration or termination, guaranteeing at least 90 days of assistance, and requiring IBM's data to be exported and delivered within 30 days. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits a guaranteed six-month assistance period, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, deletion, and deletion certification. The change is focused and preserves the remaining commercial terms, although “at least ninety (90) Days” leaves the assistance period's ultimate endpoint unclear.
